hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults. The beforeSwap hook fulfills swaps using a custom bonding curve, depositing input tokens into Euler vaults and withdrawing output tokens, while enforcing a curve invariant on reserves. Liquidity addition and donations are blocked; each pool is a delegatecall proxy of this implementation.
